decisions.statement: No free shipping option is approved for shipped orders.
dependencies: Approved paid shipping services and rates

decisions.statement: Shipped machines require an approved shipping quotation before payment.
Initial service geography covers all 50 United States; Alaska and Hawaii require separately approved rates.
International fulfillment is outside the initial Epic K scope.
The customer assembles the complete cart and requests a quotation; after approval, staff prepares a Shopify draft order and sends an invoice for payment.
dependencies: Separate authorization for Shopify draft-order operations

decisions.statement: The initial delivery quotation request collects residential or commercial designation, liftgate requirements, and access information.
No numeric delivery estimate may be published without operations approval.
Only explicitly approved products may use Grafton pickup; approved pickup-eligible machines may use ordinary pickup checkout.
dependencies: Epic E and Epic F Product facts

decisions.statement: Damage and claims instructions depend on the actual carrier and shipment service; Rhino delivery follows an internal reporting process, and insurance may be recommended without guaranteeing compensation.
Warehouse or shipping operations owns shipping quotation preparation and approval.
One approved quotation covers the complete order whenever shipped machinery is involved.
Ordinary pickup checkout is permitted only when every cart item is explicitly pickup eligible.
dependencies: Authoritative Product and Variant pickup eligibility

decisions.statement: Available insurance coverage and its cost are presented as selectable quotation options before invoicing.
dependencies: Carrier insurance availability and cost evidence

decisions.statement: The customer notifies Rhino and follows applicable carrier instructions; the customer is not assumed to be authorized to file every carrier claim.
Rhino delivery is offered only through individually approved quotations and is not a generally available automatic checkout option.
Operations establishes a validity period for each approved quotation; expired or materially changed quotations require renewed approval.
Alaska and Hawaii quotation requests are permitted, but payment invoicing requires an approved rate and confirmed service availability.
